title.en: Blue Jays vs Red Sox Highlights (July 26) - Jays Fall 1-6, No Run Support for Gausman
title.ja: 岡本和真・吉田正尚が揃って無安打、ブルージェイズ対レッドソックス戦は1-6【海外の反応】

summaryJa: トロント・ブルージェイズがボストン・レッドソックスに1-6で大敗し、岡本和真は4打数無安打2三振。勝ったレッドソックス側の吉田正尚も3打数無安打と、日本人2人は揃って快音なしに終わった。ジェイズはゴーズマンが6回3失点と試合を作ったものの援護はわずか1点で、コメント欄はシュナイダー采配への批判が席巻。『ゲレロはスローピッチソフトボールをやってるみたい』『去年WSで見たチームじゃない』という嘆きが続く一方、レッドソックスファンからは『ホームスタンド8勝2敗、シリーズを取り続けよう』と余裕の声が。最後は『レッドソックスは成績以上に強い』という一言で締まった。

media.videoTitle: BLUE JAYS vs. RED SOX: Official Full Game Highlights (July 26) | 2026 MLB Season

comments.author: @KnowYourDram
comments.bodyEn: Imagine if Gausman and Ysavage got just a little run support this year…….
comments.bodyJa: 今年もゴーズマンとイサベジにほんのちょっとの打線援護があれば……と思うと

comments.author: @kaydim5921
comments.bodyEn: It must be demoralizing, which in turn, leads to them being a bit sloppier cause there is no way any of this is fun.
comments.bodyJa: これじゃ士気が下がるのも当然。こんな状況で楽しめるわけがない

comments.author: @Hyper-Qube
comments.bodyEn: ah okay. so jays pitchers just need to pitch perfect games everyday and for the rest of the season. doable....
comments.bodyJa: なるほど。つまりジェイズ投手陣は毎日パーフェクトゲームを投げればいいってことか。できるできる……

comments.author: @DiamondD-g4o
comments.bodyEn: Schneider is deer in the headlights when batting...how many balls that are right down the middle is he going to look at?🙄
comments.bodyJa: シュナイダーは打席でフリーズしてる。ど真ん中を何球見逃せば気が済むんだ？🙄

comments.author: @LukeLovesRoids
comments.bodyEn: He's scared to swing. He had this issue earlier in the season but he was walking a ton. When he got send down to AAA they told him to chase pitches and work on batting balls. He didn't do that, he kept walking. His BA was low but his OBP was stupid high because he would just take pitches. It seems it's just engraved in him. Not to mention he's the worst Qualified Left fielder in the league right now
comments.bodyJa: 振るのが怖いんだよ。前半もこの問題があったが、そのときは四球を大量に選んでた。3Aに落とされたとき追いかける打撃をするよう言われたのに従わず相変わらず選び続けた。打率は低いがOBPは異常に高かった。それが染み付いてる。今や現在の左翼部門で最弱のリーグ選手だし

comments.author: @stanbrackhage
comments.bodyEn: he is one of many rally killers in the team. A guy that's going to have an infield fly when guys are on-base with less than two outs. The team has too many, giminez, varsho, schneider. Easy outs that pitchers just throw fastball down the pipe at.
comments.bodyJa: 彼はチームの流れを殺す選手の一人。二死前に内野フライを上げるタイプ。チームにこういう選手が多すぎる——ヒメネス、バルショー、シュナイダー。投手からすれば真ん中にファストボール放り込むだけで楽に取れる

comments.author: @jamesfawcett3074
comments.bodyEn: Shuffle off to Buffalo Schneider
comments.bodyJa: バッファローに帰れ、シュナイダー

comments.author: @Red_Sector_7
comments.bodyEn: Jays strand a ton of runners on the base pads. No run support for the starting pitcher has been a huge problem all season.
comments.bodyJa: ジェイズはランナーを大量に残しすぎる。先発に援護がないのが今季ずっと続いてる大問題

comments.author: @Vreeks4542
comments.bodyEn: You know Schneider has given up on the win when Little comes out. We would lose a 12 run lead in the 9th with this guy on the mound
comments.bodyJa: リトルが出てきた瞬間にシュナイダーが勝利を諦めたとわかる。あいつが登板したら9回に12点差があっても逆転されかねん

comments.author: @shrapnel77
comments.bodyEn: This isn't the same team I saw in the WS last year. Guerrero looks like he's playing slow pitch softball.
comments.bodyJa: これは去年のWS出場チームとは別物だ。ゲレロはスローピッチソフトボールをやってるような感じ

comments.author: @chrisd4112
comments.bodyEn: That's offensive to slow pitch softball league players.
comments.bodyJa: スローピッチソフトボールリーグの選手たちに失礼

comments.author: @zwenzzz
comments.bodyEn: when they get paid big for years, they become too comfortable.
comments.bodyJa: 大金をもらって何年もやると、安定しすぎてしまうんだよ

comments.author: @markcharron9748
comments.bodyEn: Jays should have kept Ty France and let Guerrero walk . Imagine the players they could pay for that half a billion in the next 10 years??????
comments.bodyJa: ジェイズはタイ・フランスを残してゲレロを放出すればよかった。その5億ドルで次の10年間にどれだけのことができたか……

comments.author: @emrsjoy
comments.bodyEn: Guerrero as the face of the team is alarming at this point. The future looks concerning if the top hitter can't get it together into July.
comments.bodyJa: ゲレロをチームの顔として据えるのが正直不安になってきた。7月になっても立て直せないなら先が心配

comments.author: @dannagy546
comments.bodyEn: Sad to see Connelly Early go, he was a great pitcher, but a hot bat is a good thing. That curve ball Suarez throws is nastyyyy

comments.author: @huckleberry12
comments.bodyEn: if Duran can continue hitting like this the sox are gonna be a tough out.
comments.bodyJa: デュランがこの調子で打ち続けるなら、レッドソックスはやばい相手になるぞ

comments.author: @CornPop471
comments.bodyEn: Keep winning series. 8-2 on the home stand

comments.author: @brianhildreth9099
comments.bodyEn: I'm bummed to see Early go, but i do like the trade. I think this roster is looking deep. I see them winning a lot of games and those wins will come from different players contributing on different nights. Excited for this half of the season. Go Sox.
comments.bodyJa: アーリーを放出するのは残念だが、このトレードは好き。ロスターに深みが出てきてる。いろんな選手が違う夜に貢献して勝ちを積み重ねていくイメージ。今季後半が楽しみ。行けレッドソックス

comments.author: @timmckay5117
comments.bodyEn: I'm liking the younger age of the team in general. With a lot of players yet to hit their athletic prime it can only get better if they're able to keep the core together.
comments.bodyJa: チームが全体的に若くなってきてるのが好き。まだピークを迎えてない選手が多いから、コアを維持できればどんどん良くなるはず

comments.author: @shooterG512

comments.author: @gdb9237

comments.bodyEn: Well, at least George Springer is showing signs of his 2025 self. Hoping that Vladdy can do the same soon. Daulton Varsho did well defensively but need the rest of the Jays to find their groove offensively.
comments.bodyJa: 少なくともスプリンガーは2025年の自分を取り戻しつつある。ブラディーにも早く同じことが起きてほしい。バルショーは守備でよくやったけど、打線全体がグルーブを取り戻す必要がある
